summary: Iteration 7 follow-up fixes VERIFIED — both frontend regressions are resolved. FIX 1 (debounce via useRef): rapid triple-tap on share-pdf-btn fires exactly ONE POST /api/report/pdf and produces exactly ONE download (was 2 in iteration 7). FIX 2 (web error surface): forcing a route-level abort on /api/report/pdf triggers `window.alert('Could not create the report\n\nFailed to fetch')` on web, then after unrouting a single tap succeeds again — proving the sharingRef guard resets in `finally`. REGRESSION all green: single-tap download filename = 'AiDerma-Seborrheic-Keratosis-2026-01-01.pdf' (starts with AiDerma-, ends .pdf), window.print never called, result screen renders fully, note add/edit/persist works ('itchy for 2 weeks' survives reload), refresh while logged in lands on Home (testID trial-banner), never stuck on bootstrap-screen. Backend re-run: 8/8 tests pass (test_report_pdf.py) — POST /api/report/pdf 200 with %PDF- (~1.3KB), unauth=401, base64-JPEG PDF renders, filename sanitisation intact, /api/auth/login, /api/auth/me, /api/activation-tool all 200. Native PDF path (expo-print + expo-sharing) not testable in web preview.

critical_code_review_comments: result.tsx onShare now uses `sharingRef` (useRef<boolean>) — the ref is set to true synchronously before any awaited work, so a second onPress in the same tick short-circuits at line 58 before shareReport() runs. Verified empirically: triple-tap yields 1 POST + 1 download.
The `finally` block resets both sharingRef.current and setSharing(false), so after any failure (including our simulated route.abort) the button is fully usable again — verified end-to-end.
Web-only alert branch `Platform.OS === 'web' ? window.alert(...) : Alert.alert(...)` surfaces failures reliably. Native path is code-inspected but not exercised on web preview.

Cancel/dismiss regex `/cancel|dismiss/i` correctly suppresses user-initiated cancellation errors from the native share sheet without swallowing genuine 'Failed to fetch' errors — validated by seeing the alert on abort.

rca_of_issue:
Both iteration-7 defects had textbook fixes and both are now closed:
  1) Debounce: state-based `if (sharing) return; setSharing(true)` failed because React state is not committed synchronously — the second onPress in the same tick saw sharing=false. Fixed by hoisting the flag into a useRef (`sharingRef.current`) that is set imperatively before the awaited work, then cleared in `finally`. Verified: 3 clicks → 1 POST.
  2) Silent web error: react-native-web has no Alert.alert renderer here, so the catch block was a no-op on web. Fixed with a Platform.OS === 'web' branch that calls window.alert(`${title}\n\n${body}`). Verified: aborting the network call produces a visible browser alert.
